onboarding/registration-complete.lifecyc: As admin (API), create a real branch self-signup invite for the tenant's Malaysia branch node (revoked in teardown).
Create a FRESH test-prefixed user via the sign-up API and mark it email-verified directly in the dev control-panel DB (Better-Auth blocks unverified sign-ins).
Log in through the real /login UI with ?registrationToken=<invite> — assert login forwards to /register?token=<invite>.
Step 1: assert email prefilled from the session; fill phone, IC, address, city/state/country/postal, date of birth; Continue.
Step 2: fill emergency contact name, relationship, phone; Continue.
Step 3: pick the Malaysia country card, open the branch select, choose the tenant's branch; Submit.

API-boundary assertions: get-session shows role='user' and phone persisted as +60123456789; auth/userContext shows a client-role membership in the org; members/list (as admin) shows the tenant member row.
Teardown: members/remove deletes the member from both DBs; SQL deletes the session/account/user auth rows; the invite is revoked.
As admin (already a tenant member), create a fresh invite (revoked in teardown).
POST registration/complete with a fully-formed payload and the REAL invite token.
Assert 409 CONFLICT ('already a member') — the invite passes redemption but the member check blocks double-registration, and the admin's profile is not mutated.
